title: Beware the Mad Dentist
overview: Ame is restrained by the Mad Dentist and is about to undergo dangerous cavity treatment. It's a desperate crisis! But is there a secret in Ame's mouth...?

title: Ame's Cavity
overview: Caries, a cavity, remodels Ame's teeth without asking and pushes her around. Seeing that Ame can't fit in with her friends, Caries tries to solve it with her specialty: DIY.

title: TV Raising Project
overview: Ame is happy that her baby tooth fell out. But that was Caries' precious TV! Caries carefully nurtures the newly growing tooth, eventually growing it into a giant TV, but...

title: Is the White Powder Dangerous?
overview: Ame is banned from eating sweets by her mom. Unable to watch Caries suffer from not eating sweets, her friend Mikan secretly gives them sugar, but they get involved in unexpected trouble.

title: Pushed Around by Him
overview: When Ame wakes up, Caries and a mysterious fish, Harold, are flirting inside her mouth! Ame doesn't accept Harold, who claims to be Caries' boyfriend. However, Caries is head over heels for Harold...

title: Catch the Tooth Thief
overview: Believing the rumor of the Tooth Fairy who "exchanges lost teeth for money," Ame and friends sleep with teeth under their pillows. But they were all stolen! Caries stands up for the sake of the children.

title: The Dentist Isn't Scary
overview: Mom took Ame to... the dentist!? If the cavity is found, it's game over! Ame and Caries panic and frantically clean up Caries' room, but...

title: The Tantrum Rampage
overview: Ame finds a toy she wants and tries throwing a tantrum imitating Mikan and the others, but she isn't making enough noise to get it bought. Unable to watch, Caries helps her out, but...

title: The Tooth Fairy
overview: The real Tooth Fairy got caught in the trap set to catch the tooth thief!? They immediately try to exchange the lost tooth for money, but the Tooth Fairy's assessment is stricter than imagined.

title: Caries Moves Out
overview: Caries fights with Ame and storms out of the room. She relies on Mikan and the others, trying to get them to let her stay in their mouths, but...

title: Curses Make Money
overview: A massive amount of teeth growing inside Caries' room! It seems Ame entered a cursed place. To increase the teeth, Caries tries various curses on Ame.

title: Operation: Christmas
overview: Ame and Caries write letters for what they want for Christmas. However, the presents don't arrive, and Caries gets depressed. Just then, a certain surprise arrives.

title: Alien Abduction
overview: The city is attacked by aliens! Ame and friends are abducted by a UFO and are in a huge pinch. Can they escape from the UFO with Mikan and Beef...?

title: In Place of Mom
overview: Ame sighs, unable to hand an envelope to a certain man. "Could it be Mom's first love!?" Caries goes to deliver the love letter in Ame's place.

title: Parenting Isn't Easy
overview: Harold has a secret child!? Caries is furious, but it was actually a baby living inside Harold's mouth. Caries is entrusted with the baby and struggles with parenting for the first time.

title: UMA Exists!
overview: Caries becomes famous as a new species of UMA due to a video Mikan posted. A large crowd rushes to Ame's house to catch a glimpse of Caries.

title: Guardian Giga-Teeth
overview: Ame tries to pull out a loose baby tooth. Caries, not wanting her furniture removed, remodels the baby tooth into a security AI robot, "Giga-Teeth," but...

title: No Entry Allowed
overview: The children enjoy a food tour. However, they are refused entry at a high-end restaurant. Caries comes up with a plan for the sad Ame and friends.

title: Caries' Body Journey
overview: Ame catches a cold and is bedridden. Caries dives into Ame's body to search for the cause of the cold and finds a virus tormenting Ame there.

title: Full of Cavities
overview: Because she forgot to brush her teeth, a massive number of Caries clones appear!? Caries is pushed around by the clones living as they please inside Ame's mouth...

title: Caries Cooking
overview: Mikan does a livestream closely following Caries' life. Caries struggles to make a cake during the stream, but she can't gather the ingredients as she hoped...
